label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 79
title: MVP: spec diagram viewer - embedded mermaid + draw.io + PDF
body:
## Original (as captured) Render the per-feature spec diagrams in the dashboard: interactive mermaid, a draw.io source download, and an embedded PDF/SVG. Depends on backend forge:spec-diagram-render. ## Context (from linked item product_forge:BI-0097) The per-feature spec must emit diagrams as TAGGED ```mermaid fences (stateDiagram-v2, sequenceDiagram, erDiagram, flowchart) and the pipeline must render them to draw.io source (.drawio) and SVG/PDF (derived artifacts, BI-0087). Use core/architecture_diagram.py + pipeline.pdf_generator; write derived diagrams under products/

/artifacts// (e.g. design-spec.diagrams.drawio, design-spec.diagrams.pdf). Also fix spec Links to use explicit FR-/NFR-/US- ids. [OWNER DECISION 2026-09-22] DIAGRAM RENDERING MUST SUCCEED. Diagrams in specs MUST actually render to .drawio/SVG/PDF. The observed "[DIAGRAMS] ... 0 rendered via unavailable" (renderer unavailable) is unacceptable: either make the renderer available or the stage must still emit drawio/svg/pdf. ## Links - backend_item: product_forge:BI-0097
